title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-09-05-r36.

This cumulative reader preserves Korean EGA material admitted by source, translation, typesetting and deterministic QA gates. It contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme/table of contents; and a contiguous translation of the EGA II main text through §2.1.7, canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1535. EGA II and the complete EGA corpus remain incomplete. No claim of corpus completion, finality, infallibility, perfection or external human certification is made.

The stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 identifies the evolving Korean EGA lineage. The exact-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22217711 identifies this immutable r36 checkpoint. Working repository: github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko.

The r36 increment translates Corollaries §2.1.4 and §2.1.5 with their proofs, Lemma §2.1.6 with all six assertions and its proof, and Corollary §2.1.7 with its proof, canonical lines 1449–1535. It preserves the distinctions among finite type and finite generation, the l.c.m./monomial argument, Veronese modules and algebras, every degree bound and all four references. The printed statement in §2.1.6 gives m≥m_0, while the proof's chosen greatest exceptional weighted degree directly yields m>m_0; the Korean edition preserves both loci and records that adding one to the proof-defined maximum supplies the stated threshold.

The admitted canonical prefix is 70,120 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 ED3DC79E9408C4D5325D24F3FF1CB06548611C5C8BD79CC67348402D9A0C0D91. The new 4,009-character source slice is 4,096 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 F9AE6849245F4B23482B75B8CD8A4FC0999717A2A1DFB49B160C5EF9F58D07E3. The Korean target is 71,548 bytes, SHA-256 24274A13350C1D2724F02EB1591CABD5774A9B57A5833108E94F307A2E4869D3; the admitted candidate is 4,716 bytes, SHA-256 702F60DEAACEB6F5A915F300DC0F3344824DFCF677EC8FEEADF8F9A3BEF71D63.

The cumulative PDF has 237 pages, 1,474,518 bytes, SHA-256 5FC588FF0A50B8A12899597D49FEB1B6E41BAB43F40F14E8F5433A5FB29D093D, and retains 226 historical printed-page markers. Two clean four-pass XeLaTeX cycles require pass 3 and pass 4 to be byte-identical within each cycle and require the final PDFs to be byte-identical across cycles. Evidence binds editable TeX, coverage, source authority, terminology and translation controls, complete expert-review views, build logs, extraction, links, selected renders and SHA-256 inventories. Legacy Type1 mathematics fonts lack complete ToUnicode mappings: extracted mathematical text is not lossless; TeX and rendered formulas remain authoritative. Hard reproducible checks establish tested properties, not perfection. Defects and uncertainties are corrected in later immutable versions.

Historical creators: Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. This independent translation is not endorsed by the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, source publishers, repositories or cited third parties.

It makes no blanket public-domain or open-license claim for the underlying mathematical work, historical French edition, NUMDAM files, bibliography or third-party content. Each source retains its own provenance, attribution, author/source relationship, rights and licence status.
